findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V143 renders shows the overskirt is substantially more crumpled and faceted after cloth settling, with jagged, uneven hem contours across front, back, and side views. The neutral silhouette is not a controlled pleated garment surface.

Crouch continues to expose the upper thighs and collapses the skirt around the leg forms; sit lifts and bunches the skirt into angular folded panels, while prone spreads it into a broad stiff sheet. Routing the overskirt through the static neutral cloth stage has not fixed pose-dependent deformation.
A projecting ledge and abrupt transition remain at the waist-to-hip join. Angular surface artifacts remain visible over the torso and skirt sides in the inspected views.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. Do not treat neutral cloth settling as motion or fit evidence. Rework skirt panel silhouette and rigged pose behavior, resolve the waist/hip discontinuity and torso surface artifacts, then regenerate and directly inspect all eleven views. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, and VRChat remain independent unverified gates.
